race.comment: BRINDAVAN (2) doesn't really have too many holes to punch in his form, despite missing as fav in his last two. Should be at this top now and gets the key booking of Thompson. Is sure to be right there again. ALL KINDS OF FOLK (14) was back to her best last week when launching down the centre of the Doomben track to score. Full of confidence and is in this up to her ears on the quick turnaround. NAILS MURPHY (11) is a handy gelding on his day and can bounce back off a disappointing effort here last time. Gets in light and will take some holding out if he's on-song. ESJAY (1) has hit the line hard in both runs back and should be hitting his straps now third-up. Gets some help at the weights with McMurray's claim and rates a winning chance. CUNNAMULLA FELLA (3) is model of consistency for the Heathcote camp and is always a must for exotics. The wide draw will test Rodd but suspect they will spear across early and be handy.
